name: Cold waves & winter storms
summary: No major cold wave or winter storm found; UK warnings on 8 Nov were yellow, for fog
state: Met Office warnings on 8 Nov were all yellow and for fog, with no amber or red in force (Met Office). Cold weather and low wind and solar output led to early gas storage withdrawals in Europe around 5–6 Nov (Trading Economics), but no top-tier cold or winter-storm warning over a major region was found. Searches on 8 Nov found no cold outbreak causing widespread power or gas outages.
for_you: Met Office warnings give the current UK position. Fog can disrupt roads and flights where yellow warnings apply.
rubric_hit: Normal: no major cold wave or winter storm affecting large populations (Met Office: 8 yellow, 0 amber, 0 red on 8 Nov)

sources.title: Trading Economics — EU natural gas news stream

why: Severe cold and winter storms kill, cut power and spike gas demand, as in Texas in 2021; they matter most when energy supplies are tight.
drivers: Polar vortex disruption, blocking highs, ENSO, Arctic outbreaks.

rubric.alert: Deadly cold or winter storms with widespread power or gas outages.
rubric.watch: Top-tier cold or winter-storm warnings across a major region, or a cold wave lifting gas demand sharply.
rubric.normal: No major cold wave or winter storm affecting large populations.
